description: AI + Education: India’s first AI university to set up in Maharashtra
body_lead: Maharashtra to get India's first AI university led by industry experts Artificial Intelligence is ready to enter education as India prepares to establish its first AI university. The Maharashtra government has begun preparations and recently formed a task force comprising leaders from the industry and tech giants like Tech Mahindra. Maharashtra is all set to become the first Indian state to lay the foundation of the first AI university.
